## v1.0

First release on the Flipper Apps Catalog.

- 30 levels of generated terrain, ending on a victory screen
- Two-level tutorial that adapts to the chosen thrust mode and difficulty
- Seeds 1 to 9999, each its own set of 30 levels; OK on the Seed row picks a random one
- Landing pads pay 1x, 2x, 3x or 5x; the farther, narrower pads pay more
- Three button thrust modes (Tap Impulse, Binary, Ramp) on Up or OK, chosen in Settings
- Four tilt modes for the Video Game Module, including Full Tilt: tilt forward to fire the engine
- Fuel modes: refuel every level, or one tank for the whole game, where landing with an empty tank ends the run
- Difficulty presets (Easy, Medium, Hard, Realistic) and custom landing limits
- The crash banner shows the touchdown speeds and why you crashed
- Pause menu: tap Back while flying for Resume, Zero tilt (tilt modes) or Quit to menu; hold Back 1 second to return to the menu
- Sound and vibration, each Off, Low, Med or High, and silent in Stealth mode
- The backlight stays on while you fly, so Full Tilt descents don't go dark
- High score (with the seed it was set on), settings and menu choices are saved to the SD card
- TV mode corrects the stretched picture on the Video Game Module's HDMI output
- Optional debug HUD
